---
description: "Use when implementing code in this workspace: enforce auto Haiku -> qa-gate loop until PASS."
applyTo: "**"
---

## Mandatory flow
1. Generate/fix code.
2. Immediately invoke `@qa-gate`.
3. If `BLOCKED`, fix and invoke `@qa-gate` again.
4. Handoff only when `PASS`.

## Hard rules
- Never ask user to run tests if agent can run them.
- Never create planning/status markdown unless user explicitly asks.
- Never handoff code without QA PASS.

## Output contract
- QA output starts with exactly `PASS` or `BLOCKED`.
- Final handoff ends with `✅ HANDOFF READY`.
